QuestInfo.name: Monster Purge
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra has a special task for you, due to your past experience in monster extermination.
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra will give you a special gift box for wiping out 999 monsters around your level. You'll get more rewards if you open the box at higher levels. Levels 30, 70, and 100 are the tiers for everyone. There's a special tier at Lv.50 and above for Dual Blades, Cannoneers, Evan, Mercedes, Phantom, Luminous, Battle Mages, Wild Hunters, and Mechanics.
QuestInfo.2: You wiped out 999 monsters for Cassandra and received a gift box. Do you really feel comfortable with fulfilling all of her grim whims?

mob.0: Hunt 999 monsters that are around your level!
